title: Description of a unary input
statement: For every family $C$ of directed acyclic circuits and every natural number $n$, the description assigned by $C$ to the unary input consisting of $n$ ones is the encoding of the circuit in the family for inputs of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a family of directed acyclic circuits
